args.query: SELECT contour, indicator, value, unit, as_of, target_date, flag, stale, error_bp, probabilities, model FROM v_key_rate_dashboard ORDER BY contour, indicator
SELECT DISTINCT event_date FROM v_events_calendar WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%' AND event_date >= toDate('2026-11-15') ORDER BY event_date LIMIT 8

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),
     r AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate'),
     x AS (SELECT meeting, emergency,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <  meeting)     AS rate_before,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <= meeting + 4) AS rate_after
           FROM m CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY meeting, emergency)
SELECT meeting, emergency, rate_before, rate_after,
       round((rate_after - rate_before) * 100) AS step_bp
FROM x WHERE meeting >= toDate('2024-01-01') ORDER BY meeting

WITH d AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
           WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate' AND date >= toStartOfYear(toDate('2026-11-15')) - 15
           ORDER BY date WITH FILL FROM toStartOfYear(toDate('2026-11-15')) - 15 TO toDate('2026-11-16')
           INTERPOLATE (value AS value))
SELECT max(date) AS through, count() AS days, round(avg(value), 4) AS ytd_avg,
       argMax(value, date) AS rate_now
FROM d WHERE date >= toStartOfYear(toDate('2026-11-15'))

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),
     r AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate'),
     x AS (SELECT meeting, emergency,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <  meeting)     AS rate_before,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <= meeting + 4) AS rate_after
           FROM m CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY meeting, emergency),
     s AS (SELECT meeting, emergency, round((rate_after - rate_before) * 100) AS step_bp
           FROM x WHERE rate_before IS NOT NULL AND rate_after IS NOT NULL)
SELECT step_bp, count() AS n, min(meeting) AS first, max(meeting) AS last
FROM s WHERE emergency = 0 AND meeting >= toDate('2014-01-01')
GROUP BY step_bp ORDER BY step_bp

SELECT decision_date, secid, series_name,
       argMax(settle, date) AS implied_rate,
       argMax(expected_change_bp, date) AS implied_change_bp,
       argMax(volume, date) AS volume, argMax(openposition, date) AS oi,
       max(date) AS as_of
FROM v_keyrate_expectations WHERE decision_date >= toDate('2026-11-15')
GROUP BY decision_date, secid, series_name ORDER BY decision_date

SELECT meeting_date, indicator, year, any(lo) AS lo, any(hi) AS hi
FROM v_cbr_mt_forecast
WHERE indicator IN ('key_rate_avg', 'cpi_dec', 'cpi_avg', 'gdp_yoy')
  AND meeting_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT meeting_date FROM v_cbr_mt_forecast
                       ORDER BY meeting_date DESC LIMIT 3)
GROUP BY meeting_date, indicator, year ORDER BY indicator, year, meeting_date

SELECT meeting_date, decision_action, decision_rate, decision_delta_bp,
       next_meeting_date, leftUTF8(signal, 900) AS signal, published
FROM v_cbr_key_rate_press ORDER BY meeting_date DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT block, subsection, count() AS paragraphs, sum(lengthUTF8(text)) AS chars
FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23')
GROUP BY block, subsection ORDER BY block, subsection

SELECT publication_date, title, topic, period, planned
FROM v_cbr_publication_calendar
WHERE title ILIKE 'Оперативная справка%инфляционных ожиданий%'
  AND publication_date >= toDate('2026-09-01') ORDER BY publication_date
SELECT * FROM v_point_in_time_version

SELECT seq, kind, text FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23')
  AND block LIKE 'Выводы для денежно-кредитной политики%' AND seq <= 5 ORDER BY seq

SELECT seq, kind, text FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23')
  AND block LIKE 'Выводы для денежно-кредитной политики%' AND seq > 5 ORDER BY seq
SELECT meeting_date, published FROM v_cbr_mp_summary WHERE meeting_date >= toDate('2026-09-01') ORDER BY meeting_date
SELECT DISTINCT series FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series ILIKE '%ИПЦ%' OR series ILIKE '%нфляц%' OR series ILIKE '%жидаем%' OR series ILIKE '%наблюдаем%' ORDER BY series
SELECT DISTINCT series FROM v_rosstat_macro WHERE series ILIKE '%потребительских цен%' OR series ILIKE '%безработ%' OR series ILIKE '%заработная плата%' ORDER BY series

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('ожидаемая инфляция', 'наблюдаемая инфляция')
  AND date >= toDate('2025-01-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('Базовый ИПЦ', 'Индексы потребительских цен на товары и услуги по Российской Федерации')
  AND date >= toDate('2025-06-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series = 'Индексы потребительских цен на товары и услуги по Российской Федерации'
ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT * FROM v_weekly_cpi_sa ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT * FROM v_weekly_cpi_rolling3m ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_rosstat_macro
WHERE series IN ('Индексы потребительских цен на товары и услуги по Российской Федерации',
                 'Индексы потребительских цен на услуги по Российской Федерации',
                 'Индексы потребительских цен на продовольственные товары по Российской Федерации',
                 'Индексы потребительских цен на непродовольственные товары по Российской Федерации')
  AND date >= toDate('2026-06-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_survey
WHERE series IN ('price_expectations_sa','price_growth_expected_sa','business_climate_sa','capacity_utilization_sa','headcount_expectations_sa','staff_availability_sa','credit_conditions')
  AND date >= toDate('2025-12-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT series, max(date) AS last_date, count() AS n
FROM v_rosstat_macro
WHERE series ILIKE '%Индекс%потребительских цен%' OR series = 'Уровень безработицы'
   OR series ILIKE '%заработная плата%' OR series = 'Безработные'
GROUP BY series ORDER BY series

SELECT date, value FROM v_rosstat_macro
WHERE series = 'Индекс потребительских цен (недельная оценка)'
ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 12

WITH s AS (
  SELECT date, value AS idx FROM v_rosstat_macro
  WHERE series = 'Индексы потребительских цен на товары и услуги по Российской Федерации'
    AND date >= toDate('2024-09-01')
)
SELECT date, idx,
       round((idx/100 - 1)*100, 3) AS mom_pct,
       round((exp(sum(log(idx/100)) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) - 1)*100, 3) AS yoy_pct,
       round((exp(avg(log(idx/100)) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)*12) - 1)*100, 2) AS ann3m_pct
FROM s ORDER BY date
SELECT DISTINCT series FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series ILIKE '%М2%' OR series ILIKE '%Кредит%' OR series ILIKE '%Требования%' OR series ILIKE '%Депозит%' ORDER BY series

SELECT series, title, unit, frequency FROM v_series_catalog
WHERE series IN ('М2 SA','Денежная масса М2','Кредит экономике','Требования к организациям','Требования к населению*',
 'Депозиты населения','депозиты физических лиц','кредиты физическим лицам','корпоративные кредиты',
 'Всего: свыше 1 года','Средневзвешенная ставка по жилищным кредитам, РФ','всего') ORDER BY series

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('М2 SA','Кредит экономике','Требования к организациям','Требования к населению*','Депозиты населения')
  AND date >= toDate('2025-11-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT series, origin, description FROM v_series_catalog
WHERE series IN ('Всего: свыше 1 года','Всего (кредиты физлицам): по всем срокам','Средневзвешенная ставка по жилищным кредитам, РФ','депозиты физических лиц','до 30 дней, кроме "до востребования"') ORDER BY series

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_rosstat_macro
WHERE series IN ('Уровень безработицы','Среднемесячная номинальная начисленная заработная плата работников по полному кругу организаций')
  AND date >= toDate('2025-12-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT source, series, date, value FROM v_minfin_budget
WHERE date >= toDate('2026-09-01')
  AND series IN ('Доходы, всего','Расходы, всего','Дефицит (-)/Профицит (+)','Нефтегазовые доходы, всего')
ORDER BY series, source, date

SELECT series, date, value FROM v_cbr_macro
WHERE series IN ('Всего: свыше 1 года','Всего (кредиты физлицам): по всем срокам','Средневзвешенная ставка по жилищным кредитам, РФ','до 30 дней, кроме "до востребования"')
  AND date >= toDate('2026-01-01') ORDER BY series, date

SELECT source, series, count() AS months, round(sum(value),1) AS ytd_sum, max(date) AS last_date,
       round(argMax(value, date),1) AS last_value
FROM v_minfin_budget
WHERE date >= toDate('2026-01-01') AND date <= toDate('2026-10-31')
  AND series IN ('Доходы, всего','Расходы, всего','Дефицит (-)/Профицит (+)','Нефтегазовые доходы, всего')
GROUP BY source, series ORDER BY series, source

SELECT publication_date, title, period FROM v_cbr_publication_calendar
WHERE publication_date >= toDate('2026-11-15') AND publication_date <= toDate('2026-12-18')
  AND (title ILIKE '%инфляц%' OR title ILIKE 'Мониторинг предприятий%'
       OR title ILIKE '%кредит экономике%' OR title ILIKE '%Денежно-кредитные условия%'
       OR title ILIKE '%процентные ставки по кредит%' OR title ILIKE 'Оперативная справка%')
ORDER BY publication_date

SELECT 'brent' AS what, max(date) AS as_of, argMax(value, date) AS value FROM v_moex_market WHERE series = 'brent_front'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'usd_rub', max(date), argMax(value, date) FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_currency_usd'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ruonia', max(date), argMax(value, date) FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_ruania_ruo'
SELECT * FROM v_ofz_signal ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT metric, stage, model, forecast_date, target_date, predicted, actual, error_bp, is_resolved
FROM v_ml_live_accuracy
WHERE metric LIKE 'cbr_rate:%' AND model != 'gate-selftest'
ORDER BY target_date DESC, metric LIMIT 20

SELECT release_year, indicator, year, lo, hi, announcement_date, publication_status
FROM v_cbr_ondkp_forecast WHERE indicator IN ('key_rate','inflation','gdp') ORDER BY year, release_year

SELECT seq, kind, leftUTF8(text, 700) AS text FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23') AND block = 'Инфляционные риски' ORDER BY seq
SELECT DISTINCT meeting_date, release_date FROM v_cbr_mt_forecast ORDER BY meeting_date DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT seq, block, leftUTF8(text, 600) AS text FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23') AND subsection = 'Основные факты' ORDER BY block, seq

SELECT meeting_date, block, leftUTF8(text, 400) AS text FROM v_cbr_mp_summary_blocks
WHERE meeting_date = toDate('2026-10-23') AND (text ILIKE '%разов%' OR text ILIKE '%временн%' OR text ILIKE '%индексац%')
ORDER BY block, seq LIMIT 12

WITH m AS (SELECT event_date AS meeting, max(emergency) AS emergency
           FROM v_events_calendar
           WHERE category = 'cbr' AND title LIKE '%заседание по ключевой ставке%'
             AND event_date < toDate('2026-11-15') GROUP BY event_date),
     r AS (SELECT date, value FROM v_cbr_macro WHERE series = 'cbr_key_rate'),
     x AS (SELECT meeting, emergency,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <  meeting)     AS before,
                  argMaxIf(value, date, date <= meeting + 4) AS after
           FROM m CROSS JOIN r GROUP BY meeting, emergency),
     s AS (SELECT meeting, round((after - before) * 100) AS step_bp FROM x WHERE before IS NOT NULL AND after IS NOT NULL AND emergency = 0),
     t AS (SELECT meeting, step_bp,
                  lagInFrame(step_bp) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS p1,
                  lagInFrame(step_bp, 2) OVER (ORDER BY meeting) AS p2
           FROM s)
SELECT multiIf(p2 = 0 AND p1 = 0, 'two+ holds before', p1 < 0, 'cut before', p1 > 0, 'hike before', p1 = 0, 'one hold before', 'n/a') AS context,
       step_bp, count() AS n
FROM t WHERE meeting >= toDate('2014-01-01')
GROUP BY context, step_bp ORDER BY context, step_bp
